content_text:
Dear Roger,
outside of the obvious color temperature differences of the contrasting environments in ‘Sicario’ and ‘Prisoners’, the camera tint in ‘Sicario’ generally seems to lean a little towards green while in ‘Prisoners’ it seems to lean a little towards magenta.
Am I just imagining that or do you use green/magenta tint to adjust the look for a certain story?
